set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Row with an unknown number of persons
set.stimulus:
A certain number of persons sit in a straight row facing north. P, Q, R, S and T are among them; the others are not named. They are not necessarily seated in the same order.

1. T sits third from the right end of the row.
2. Q sits third from the left end of the row.
3. R sits ninth to the right of S.
4. T sits fifth to the right of Q.
5. P sits to the immediate left of R.

questions.subject: reasoning
questions.prompt: Who sits second to the right of T?

steps: Start with clues 2, 3, 1 and 5: together they fix Q, R, S, T and P.
Final arrangement from the left end: S, 1 unnamed, Q, 4 unnamed, T, P, R — 10 persons in all.
Second to the right of T: P → R — answer **R**.
solution.shortcut: Take left/right from the person’s own facing, then count seats along the row.

visual.caption: 10 persons in all; a dash marks an unnamed person.

questions.subject: reasoning
questions.prompt: Who sits second to the left of Q?

steps: Start with clues 2, 3, 1 and 5: together they fix Q, R, S, T and P.
Final arrangement from the left end: S, 1 unnamed, Q, 4 unnamed, T, P, R — 10 persons in all.
Second to the left of Q: an unnamed person → S — answer **S**.

visual.caption: 10 persons in all; a dash marks an unnamed person.

questions.subject: reasoning
questions.prompt: How many persons sit to the left of T?

steps: Start with clues 2, 3, 1 and 5: together they fix Q, R, S, T and P.
Final arrangement from the left end: S, 1 unnamed, Q, 4 unnamed, T, P, R — 10 persons in all.
To the left of T there are 7 seats up to the end of the row — **Seven**.
solution.shortcut: Persons to the left + persons to the right = total − 1.

visual.caption: 10 persons in all; a dash marks an unnamed person.

questions.subject: reasoning
questions.prompt: How many persons sit between S and Q?

steps: Start with clues 2, 3, 1 and 5: together they fix Q, R, S, T and P.
